lesson: Make product choices that remove high-friction customer work before competitors do.
action_for_founder: Test a complete automated workflow before defending a privacy or architecture constraint.

lesson: Demand is insufficient when users will not pay enough to fund distribution and product work.
action_for_founder: Test willingness to pay and acquisition economics alongside usage growth.

lesson: Validate willingness to pay and commercial path before scaling a technical team.
action_for_founder: Secure committed paid customers before expanding headcount or product scope.

lesson: Treat founder-market understanding and profitability as hypotheses, not assumed strengths.
action_for_founder: Interview and sell to the target users before repeated relaunches.

lesson: A product can grow and still be a poor strategic fit when the market and sales motion are too small.
action_for_founder: Compare addressable market and required sales motion with the firm’s capabilities before continuing investment.

lesson: A viable product path can disappear when sector funding conditions change.
action_for_founder: Set fundraising contingencies and assess sector financing before relying on the next round.

lesson: New categories may face timing, hardware, and capital constraints simultaneously.
action_for_founder: De-risk manufacturing and financing before committing to a new-device strategy.

lesson: Founders need an agreed decision process before conflicts make intuition decisive.
action_for_founder: Document decision rules and revisit them regularly.

lesson: Founder financial and family constraints are operating constraints, not background details.
action_for_founder: Assess founder availability and personal runway before committing to a venture schedule.

lesson: Revenue traction does not resolve structural business-model or defensibility questions.
action_for_founder: Test repeatable margins and a defensibility path before scaling.
